title: A Salt for the Hollow
premise: Sebastian Winterbourne has spent a decade hiding in plain sight, selling harmless charms in the city of Corvane while secretly keeping watch over the Hollow Gate—a sealed door between realms that his family swore to guard. When a dying courier presses a bloodstained map into his hands, Sebastian learns the covenant binding the gate is unraveling, and something on the other side is already pushing through. Hunted by the city's magic-hating Wardens and guided by Wren, a fugitive hedge-witch whose sister was taken beyond the gate years ago, he must journey to the gate's far anchor and reforge the covenant with his own blood and choice. In the end, Sebastian realizes the covenant demands a keeper on both sides: he offers himself as the new anchor, but Wren refuses to let him go alone, and together they bind themselves to the threshold—freeing the stolen souls, saving both realms, and choosing love over the duty that would have demanded one of them be sacrificed.
about_author: Paloma Ravensworth is the pen name of a former archivist who spent years cataloguing forbidden grimoires before turning to fiction. She writes from a coastal cottage where she keeps one window permanently open, 'just in case.'

chapters.title: The Charm Seller's Quiet Life
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian. Ten years after the Edict outlawed magic, Sebastian sells luck-knots and fever-charms in Corvane's night market while secretly tending the Hollow Gate beneath his shop. A routine inspection by the Wardens nearly exposes him. Emotional beat: the suffocating comfort of hiding, and the first crack of dread when he notices the gate humming.

chapters.title: A Stranger at the Threshold
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian. A dying man staggers into the shop at dawn, presses a bloodstained map into Sebastian's hands, and whispers that 'the anchor is failing' before dissolving into salt. The map bears Sebastian's family sigil. Emotional beat: grief and denial—the past he buried has found him.

chapters.title: What the Wardens Burn
chapters.summary: POV Wren. Hedge-witch Wren watches Wardens burn her mentor's apothecary and recognizes the dying courier's description—her sister's old contact. She tracks the map to Sebastian's shop. Emotional beat: rage sharpened into purpose; two hunted people circling the same secret.

chapters.title: The Covenant Explained
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian, with Wren present. Forced together by a Warden raid, they flee into the catacombs where Sebastian reveals the truth: the Winterbournes forged a covenant sealing the Hollow Gate, renewed each decade—and the renewal date is nineteen days away. Emotional beat: reluctant alliance; trust built out of necessity.

chapters.title: Salt Roads
chapters.summary: POV alternating. They follow the map along the dead salt roads toward the gate's far anchor, ambushed by hollow-eyed things leaking through thin places. Wren saves Sebastian with wild magic; he saves her from a Warden patrol. Emotional beat: partnership forged in shared danger; first flickers of tenderness.

chapters.title: The City That Forgot Its Name
chapters.summary: POV Wren. They reach Vesperhollow, a border town half-swallowed by the other realm, where taken souls—including Wren's sister Lark—linger as memory-ghosts. Lark warns them the covenant's price is a life freely given. Emotional beat: hope curdling into horror; love tested against sacrifice.

chapters.title: Betrayal in Thin Places
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian. Warden-Captain Ilsa Vane, who has hunted Sebastian for years, corners them—but she knows what the gate holds and offers a devil's bargain: deliver the gate to the Wardens' control or watch them seal it with Wren as the price. Emotional beat: duty weaponized; Sebastian forced to choose whom to betray.

chapters.title: Nineteen Days Become One
chapters.summary: POV alternating. The gate tears open early; salt-storms swallow the road and Vesperhollow begins to fade. Sebastian chooses neither bargain—he'll reforge the covenant the old way, at the far anchor, offering himself. He and Wren confess their feelings on the eve of likely death. Emotional beat: resolve born of love, not obligation.

chapters.title: The Reforging
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian, climax. At the far anchor, Sebastian cuts his palm to bind himself as the new keystone—but the covenant accepts only willing pairs, one from each side of the door. Wren steps through, claiming her right as a witch of the other bloodline. Together they speak the reforging as the hollow tide breaks against them. Emotional beat: terror transfigured into unity.

chapters.title: A Door Between Two Hands
chapters.summary: POV alternating, resolution. The gate steadies—not sealed shut but held open just enough for the stolen souls, including Lark, to pass home. Vane, witnessing the reforging, burns her orders and walks away. Sebastian and Wren become the gate's joint keepers, neither caged nor free, together. Emotional beat: bittersweet peace—duty remade as devotion.
